'''''Star Wars Outlaws: Low Red Moon''''' is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel  written by [[Mike Chen (author)|Mike Chen]] and published by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[February 3]], [[2026]]. The novel acts as a prequel to the [[2024]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' and features the characters [[ND-5]] and [[Jaylen Vrax]].
